reviews.t: Yellows  on clear or light but great for dark polishes.
reviews.x: Does yellow after a couple days and I don’t lay in tanning beds or smoke. It does make a beautiful coat for dark polishes. Burns if gotten on cuticle make sure to wipe off with a small detail brush before curing.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise it as a true matte finish, unlike other brands that look satin or dull.
Many say it is the best matte top coat they have tried, often after trying many other brands.
Several reviewers highlight its long wear, lasting weeks without chipping or losing the matte look.
Reviewers frequently mention the great price and value.
A few note drawbacks: it can yellow on clear or light polish and can burn if it gets on the cuticle.
